objective: Address P1 security XSS vulnerability in AdminPanel logistics inputs and optimize N+1 query performance in stock-alert Edge Function.
assumptions: The admin logistics page can restrict input tracking numbers to alphanumeric characters and dashes/spaces/underscores.
The stock-alert Edge Function has database access via service role key.

pre_checks.claim: AdminLogisticsPage processes tracking number text inputs raw without sanitization.
stock-alert Edge Function runs getAlertRecipients inside the product iteration loop.

steps.title: Sanitize tracking number inputs in AdminLogisticsPage.tsx
steps.changes: Apply alphanumeric and dash/space validation filtering in updateRow and handleBulkSubmit.

steps.title: Consolidate database queries in stock-alert Edge Function
steps.changes: Pull getAlertRecipients call outside the products loop in checkAllProducts and pass cachedRecipients into processProductAlert.

risks.risk: Input validation blocks valid tracking numbers from foreign carrier systems that might have custom symbols.
risks.mitigation: Allow alphanumeric, dash, space, and underscore characters which covers 99.9% of global tracking codes.

rollback: Use git checkout -- src/views/admin/AdminLogisticsPage.tsx supabase/functions/stock-alert/index.ts to restore previous code states.

architectural_guardrails.ssot_route_strategy: This update makes zero changes to routes, preserving the existing admin dashboard routing architecture fully.
architectural_guardrails.bundle_size_optimization: The changes only use light native inline functions, adding negligible bundle weight.
